actions.title: Optimize App Performance
actions.description: Conduct a thorough review of the app's code and infrastructure to identify and fix performance bottlenecks, ensuring a seamless user experience and preventing financial losses due to glitches. This should include resolving issues with 'exit all' functionality and external funds fetching. By doing so, we can significantly improve user satisfaction and retention.

actions.title: Review Brokerage Charges
actions.description: Assess the app's brokerage charges and fees to determine if they are competitive and transparent. Consider revising the fee structure to better align with user expectations and industry standards, ensuring that users feel they are getting a fair deal. This could involve introducing tiered pricing or promotional offers to incentivize user engagement.

actions.title: Enhance User Interface
actions.description: Redesign the app's user interface to improve navigation, clarity, and overall usability. This should include simplifying the order execution process, making stop-loss and target prices more intuitive, and providing clear and concise information to users. By streamlining the UI, we can reduce user frustration and increase the app's overall appeal.
